network.assessment: Exact native vocabulary and F1–F6 queries, domain searches in zbMATH Open/arXiv/Numdam/MathOverflow, and backward checking of Hua2026 §§76–79. The contemporary paper explicitly excludes the general orientation, restriction, F4-corollary and F6 questions. No exact published resolution of the remaining native assertion was located in this bounded search.

ficelle.assessment: French ficelle/lieu/découpage and English cone/closed quotient/noncut-point searches; zbMATH Open, arXiv, MathOverflow, Numdam, the published-work bibliography and Esquisse checked. Regular-immersion hits for schemes were rejected as different definitions. No exact later theorem in the unrestricted ficelle axioms was located.

regular.assessment: Backward search from regular-neighborhood literature, Numdam bibliography and Cohen1969 DOI. General manifold neighborhood results are not silently applied to arbitrary spaces. The finite simplicial-pair assertion has an independent elementary construction in this dossier; the blanket tame assertion lacks a fixed category.

rives.assessment: Rive/Boolean sheaf/relative spectrum queries followed to Schapira Proposition10.1.2, Godement citation, Gillam §§2.2,3.3, Stone duality, Stacks idempotents and Hua2026 Theorem77.1. These settle only the exact algebra/sheaf assertions stated, not the whole cut construction.

realization.assessment: Finite-space/poset realization, simple homotopy, stratified exit paths, and Esquisse checked with primary theorem locators. Different equivalence notions and retained geometric labels prevent identifying these results with an unspecified geometry-of-forms realization theorem.
